title: Cholera cases in Kosti
text: Health officials reported 212 suspected cholera cases and 9 deaths in Kosti, White Nile, linked to unsafe drinking water.

title: Kosti hospitals overwhelmed
text: More than 230 patients with acute watery diarrhoea were admitted in Kosti this week; 11 have died.

title: Market prices
text: Vegetable prices at the central market were stable this week.
